::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Its VIHAAN-I broadband SoC, built on C-DAC's VEGA RISC-V core and fabricated at UMC, reported first-pass silicon success in 2026; production tape-out targeted for 2027. Tamil Nadu's Emerging Sector Seed Fund has invested ₹20 crore.
:::

## What does this firm design?

GPON/EPON optical network terminal SoCs integrating compute, broadband access and system control.
